description: Defines the LineReader class for reading lines from a file descriptor without using standard file I/O functions, part of the breakpad minidump writer component.

classes.name: LineReader
classes.description: A class for reading a file line by line from a file descriptor without using fopen/fgets.

methods.name: GetNextLine
methods.description: Reads the next line from the file descriptor, returning a pointer to the line and its length.

methods.name: PopLine
methods.description: Removes the processed line from the buffer.
